Name: Colorful Chickens
Author: larkylovesyou2
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Have you ever thought Shane was wasting his potential just breeding [/color][i][color=#d4d4d8]one[/color][/i][color=#d4d4d8] variety of chicken? Well, look no further! This mod adds the remainder of the rainbow for your ranching pleasure.[/color]

[size=4][b]:: Features ::[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Adds Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Purple, and Pink Chickens. They can be purchased from Marnie's after viewing Shane's 8-heart event, the same way you would buy Blue Chickens.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Adds Blue Eggs to the existing Blue Chickens, as well as egg variants for the other new chickens! They can all be turned into their respective mayonnaise colors.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Adds the ability to purchase all egg colors from Pierre during the Egg Festival. This makes Blue Chickens technically obtainable before viewing Shane's 8-heart event, if you're willing to grind for it (or if you just don't like Shane).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Adds special Rainbow Chickens that lay rainbow eggs. Rainbow Chickens cannot be purchased from Marnie's; to get one, you must first craft a Rainbow Egg using an egg of every other color, then incubate it.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]:: Config Settings ::[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]"Colorful Chickens From Marnie":[/b] Adds all chicken colors to shop rotation after viewing Shane's 8-heart event. When false, colorful chickens can only be obtained by incubating their respective eggs. (Default: True)[/*]
[*][b]"Colorful Eggs At Egg Festival": [/b]Adds multicolored eggs to Pierre's Egg Festival stand so they can be incubated into colorful chickens. This would make blue chickens obtainable without viewing Shane's 8-heart event. (Default: True)[/*]
[*][b]"Colorful Eggs from Marnie": [/b]Adds multicolored eggs to Marnie's shop so they can be incubated into colorful chickens. This would make blue chickens obtainable without viewing Shane's 8-heart event. (Default: False) [/*]
[*][b]"Blue Eggs":[/b] Enables Blue Eggs and Blue Mayonnaise. If you're using another mod that adds blue eggs/mayo, you should disable this setting for compatibility. (Default: True)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]:: Compatibility ::[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]This mod [i][b]is[/b] [/i]compatible with other mods that add blue eggs; you can disable my mod's blue eggs & mayonnaise via the config settings so that your blue chickens will lay eggs from the other mod instead.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]:: Credits ::[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]All sprites were created by me using assets from the original game.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]HUGE shoutout to 6480's [/color][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20266]"Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo"[/url] [/color][color=#d4d4d8]and Rivalrabbit's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43600]"Em's Farm Goose and Geese"[/url]; I referenced a bit of their code in the process of making this mod.[/color][/*]
[/list]
